about: The figures of the gallery page (site/pages/gallery.astro) and the home page. scripts/gallery.mjs runs each entry through the openreadout binary on the public corpus files and writes public/img/gallery/NAME.png and site/data/gallery.json. $CORPUS is the corpus directory. Entries with `preview` are `openreadout preview FILE ARGS...`; `objects` counts objects with `stats --objects` and previews the plane with a point on each; `plot` is the spec of `openreadout plot`.

entries.name: slide-fold
entries.title: Labelled layers in a whole-slide scan
entries.caption: One fold of the cerebellum in a 3.7 GB slide scan of a young mouse, read as a 1,200 × 900 pixel region. The rulers are file pixels, so an agent can read coordinates off the picture and put its labels where it sees the layers.
